picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission marks the moment this DOE-led AI-for-science initiative became a true whole-of-government effort spanning 15+ federal agencies, set in motion by executive order — the policy umbrella under which dozens of university and lab awards this week fall.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more is among the largest single allocations in the initiative, cementing it as a central hub for federally funded AI-for-science research.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge's selection to lead nine Genesis Mission projects and contribute to 32 others represents one of the biggest national-lab commitments in the program, spanning supercomputing and quantum-AI integration.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia leading six Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 17 more underscores the scale of DOE's bet on national labs to anchor AI-driven scientific discovery infrastructure.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist steering its research, signals strong private-market confidence in AI-driven materials discovery — a rare large commercial funding event this week.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $20 million award to Boston University to help build a 20-node national 'cloud lab' network could reshape how remote, AI-automated experimentation is conducted across U.S. research institutions.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $83 million investment in integrated data infrastructure targets a foundational bottleneck for AI-driven science, aiming to make data usable at scale across many future research efforts.
picks.title: NSF announces $83M investment in integrated data systems and services to advance AI-driven science and strengthen U.S. research infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: USC's national team developing AI models to predict turbulence tackles a longstanding, computationally hard scientific problem with direct applications spanning energy and transportation systems.
picks.title: USC leads national AI research project to accelerate scientific discovery

picks.editorial_note: The UW, Carnegie Mellon, and SLAC collaboration to build a unified AI-driven cosmology data service could accelerate discovery across a major scientific field by breaking down long-standing data silos.
picks.title: UW researchers join national effort to streamline AI-driven cosmology

picks.editorial_note: NEURA Robotics' partnership with RWTH Aachen to build a large-scale physical-AI training facility for humanoid and industrial robots marks a significant academia-industry bet on embodied AI.
picks.title: A Milestone for Physical AI | RWTH Aachen University | EN
